chapter_seo_title: Foundation Establishment Pill Dilemma: Han Li’s Cost-Benefit Reckoning
chapter_meta_description: Han Li returns from battle with two Foundation Establishment Pills and a heavy choice. The reward is real—but the price is not what he expected. A quiet, calculating chapter about the cold math of the cultivation world.
og_title: Han Li Refuses the Bed, Not Out of Honor, But Out of Math
og_description: A kiss as payment. A body burned to ash. And a pill that may be more curse than blessing. This is the calm, brutal aftermath of a Mortal Stream victory.

twitter_description: After the battle, Han Li takes a cold inventory of losses, rewards, and a very inconvenient new dilemma. The Mortal Stream doesn’t let you win without a catch.
